sentences: Our school received one boxes of seeds from a local garden club last spring.
Before opening the box, I read the instructions careful.
The club suggested sort the packets by planting month, so we made four trays.
One packet was empty, and its label did not matched the list inside the box.
I sent a message to the gardener worked at the club, and she replied within a hour.
She explained that the missing seeds would arrived the next day.
We decided to wait them before putting the packets on the shelf.
When everything was ready, our teacher give us some useful advices and thanked us for the work.
